easter-egg:1.text: Cowboy Of No Name is a deceased character in Red Dead Redemption. No background about this man is known. This grave seems to be a simple odd Easter Egg.

easter-egg:3.text: Grady Underwood is a minor character featured in Red Dead Redemption. Nothing is known of Grady's background. However, it is revealed in the mission "On Shaky's Ground" that he and Vernon Cherry run with a gang of criminals with ties to Eddie Savoy and his smuggling interests. Grady has a relative, Clinton Underwood, buried in the Blackwater public cemetery.
